root: ^I was on patrol last night… Then I saw something lying on the road. He exhales, looking away for a moment. First, I thought it was just one person, but then… there were two. You, unconscious. And her.

^His voice tightens slightly. I ran to check, but it was too late. I should’ve—I should’ve been faster. Maybe then… He stops himself, shaking his head. Anyway. I don’t know the exact time. It was dark. Completely dark. I’ve never been good at telling the hour—not even now. Clocks just… don’t make sense to me.
